summary: Planned checks: task JSON/JSONL parsing, markdown/path sanity, targeted contradictory-guidance scans, optional base-version validation script tests, and git diff whitespace check.

command: ConvertFrom-Json over task.json, implement.jsonl, and check.jsonl
Test-Path for governance docs, operations docs, Trellis guide files, and ops/verify-yudi-base.ps1
rg for retired .yudi-base field names upstream_remote/upstream_repo/synced_at/YUDI_* in new docs and verifier
rg for contradictory guidance that would allow long-lived customer core patches
Select-String trailing whitespace scan over new governance docs
pwsh -File ops/verify-yudi-base.ps1 -Path <temp repo with upstream, base_tag, last_synced_at>
pwsh -File ops/verify-yudi-base.ps1 -Path <temp repo missing base_tag/base_commit and last_synced_at>
git status --short --ignored and git ls-files --others --exclude-standard for new governance files
rg for upstream governance, thin fork, overlay, cherry-pick -x, merge upstream, and .yudi-base references
